message.reasoning_content:
The previous probe failed because validate_inputs rejects poisoned V at window-expired positions: validate_inputs uses lo = length - qt - window + 1 as "live" positions, so positions in [lo, length) must be finite. Positions < lo may be arbitrary. My poisoning covered 0..lo_allowed-1 where lo_allowed = 100-4-5+1=92, but I also poisoned unreferenced pages — those are fine? Actually validate checks live = cache[mapped, positions%page] for positions in [lo, length) — mapping uses table entries for t//page. I poisoned pages 7..15 fully with NaN, but positions in [92,100) map to page table entries t//16 in [5,6] — pages 5,6 are in the perm table which could include page 7? Table was randperm(16)[:7] — includes pages 0..15 randomly, so pages 7-15 may include referenced pages. So poisoning pages 7..15 hit live positions. Fix: only poison slots at logical positions < lo_allowed, and unreferenced pages (not in table[:ceil]).

Also need to check the actual failure hypothesis: kernel's tile_start for qb=0: first_key = context + 0 - window + 1 = 96-5+1=92. tile_start = 92//64 = 1. So tile 1 covers logical 64..127. Positions 64..91 are disallowed but loaded! Poison those V slots (logical t in [64,92), all < lo_allowed=92). Those are poisonable and will be loaded in tile 1 with probabilities 0 → 0*NaN.

Wait, but validate's live check: positions from lo=92 onward must be finite. Positions 64..91 are poisonable.
